author: RafaZafar
quote:
I never ever ever leave reviews. 

This game deserves one. 

I gave it a 1 and not a zero because it's beautiful. 

But beauty is only skin deep. It's expensive. For this price, a years worth of Netflix subscription almost, I expect more. The physics glitches. Often. The things you expect from this series is totally missing. You can't bang prostitutes. You can't kill them either. You can slaughter cops in full gory detail but you can shoot up a gay club or protesters. The story is amazingly simp coded. Lucia Chuck's Jason to his face. He's such a wimpy dude and yet she offers absolutely nothing to him in return. She's God awful. I hated this woman so much, I think I'm a full on misogynist now especially seeing women saying she is "teaching" men how to be good boyfriends. This lady couldn't teach kindergarteners. She has nothing to offer and takes everything. I don't feel like a badass, I feel like a simp. I hate myself just for playing the characters. I genuinely loathe this game and all the horrible people who made it.

author: RafaZafar
quote: I know these games. I play these games. This is the best of all the souls games. I consider this basically Elden Ring 2. It's huge. Huge. HUGE! The map is intricate. The enemies are new. The vibe is unique. It's incredible. The pseudo "leveling" system is perfect for someone moving on from Elden Ring. You don't have to "level" to break meta but still have to "level" by exploring. It's great! It has new crafting, opening up entirely new builds. New weapons, new bosses, and expansion of old underused mechanics like sleep. Seeing characters mentioned in Elden Ring but unseen is fantastic. I love this. I'm having a blast.
game_title: Elden Ring: Shadow of the Erdtree
